item.text: The SQL Server pinger now uses the repository’s SQL Server driver to connect and run its ping query. It classifies refused connections and SQL Server login and database errors. I’m adding focused tests for those cases and for connection behavior.
The targeted Go tests are still compiling. I’m waiting for their result, then I’ll address any failures and check the final diff.
